4 اخبى النَّارَ He extinguished the fire; (S, K;) he allayed, or extinguished, the flaming, or blazing, of the fire. (JK, Msb.) ―
-b2- And [hence,] اخبى الحَرْبَ (tropical:) He extinguished [or allayed] the fire of the war. (K, TA.) And اخبى حِدَّةَ النَّاقَهِ (tropical:) He extinguished [or allayed] the sharpness, or irascibility, of the she-camel. (K, * TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
